Leaf sweeping

In November the paths between the plots are swept by whoever is on the site on Saturday morning. The brooms and the barrows are in the hut. Bring gloves, and take what you sweep up to the wire bins behind the hut, where it is left to rot down for two years.

Marsh Lane Allotments, 4 Marsh Lane. Open from dawn to dusk.
